items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Is Slender Talk kind of called Slender Pella?' and the interviewee responds by discussing Charlie Broodin and R.O.D., but never explicitly confirms the identity of Slender Pella nor describes a personal relationship with them.

ctx.x: Is Slender Talk kind of called Slender Pella? Yeah.

Well, at the bar meeting, he was talking about him all in the room. Yeah, Charlie Broodin. Yeah, Charlie Broodin. Yeah. I got this picture on the deck. Remember, I showed you a picture with R.O.D. I said, picture made in Florida. I was waking him in the night of the place at the Michael's nightclub. Yeah, just waking him, wake it then. And, uh, Charlie Broodin, myself, and R.O.D. Got those pictures. I showed them to you. I said, well, this one, he doesn't name Charlie Broodin. He's a piano saxophone. He was…
